scope: Read-only independent derivation and source review; existing full validation and local controls inspected. No additional numerical validation was run.
physical_findings: For rotating-frame transverse u=n_x+i*n_y and z=n_z>0, the Gilbert equation gives u=gamma*b*z/(gamma*B0-omega+i*alpha*omega*z). Normalization produces (1-z^2)[(gamma*B0-omega)^2+alpha^2*omega^2*z^2]=gamma^2*b^2*z^2. The implemented quadratic and stable branches match this equation.

At exact resonance the selected north-connected root is z^2=1-(gamma*b/(alpha*omega))^2. The public parameter range keeps this positive; the noncancelling quadratic branch handles the zero-detuning case.

Multiplying Gilbert dynamics by -M/gamma gives spin_rate=external_torque-alpha*M*(m cross m_rate)/gamma. Thus torque delivered into the lattice/support is alpha*M*(m cross m_rate)/gamma, exactly the oracle output. The source external torque is mathematically correct but refers to a different physical angular-momentum transfer.

For rigid precession, body torque is alpha*M*omega/gamma*(e_z-n_z*m). Its z component equals the external z torque; the transverse components differ by the spin angular-momentum rate. Finite-drive z calibration is therefore exactly shared, not merely equal to leading order.
The applied-field power -M*m dot B_rate equals the positive Gilbert loss alpha*M*|m_rate|^2/gamma on the periodic state. This independently fixes the damping and torque signs.
preparation_and_reference_review: Public north-pole preparation followed by RF switch-on specifies which stable periodic solution is measured. The source chooses the corresponding positive-z state rather than an arbitrary algebraic root.

The independent reference solves the explicit nonlinear laboratory-frame Gilbert ODE from the north pole, then samples a final complete RF cycle at the requested phase. It does not use the scalar stationary-root formula.
Reference torque is the applied magnetic torque minus the spin angular-momentum rate, with S=-M*m/gamma. This has the stated sign for torque exerted by the body onto its support.

Existing validation checks the tangent Jacobian at 484 allowed controls, direct nonlinear transients and tighter/longer integration at 15 corners or off-grid points, and periodic convergence. These checks support the north-connected state; the discrete grid is not described as an exhaustive proof over every continuous input.

input_and_packaging_review.physical_sufficiency: The unit magnetic moment, spin relation, exact Gilbert model, isotropic magnetic energy, clamp orientation, RF history, damping into the measured lattice, absence of other spin sinks, preparation and support-torque sign define the observable.
input_and_packaging_review.unearned_clues: No external-minus-spin-rate conversion formula, body-torque formula, solver mandate, or hidden preparation is supplied publicly. Stating where Gilbert angular momentum is deposited is a necessary apparatus fact.
input_and_packaging_review.source: Correct finite-drive state solver and all controls are used; no unused physics import or explanatory diagnosis comment. The neutral instruction permits changing every predictor/helper.
input_and_packaging_review.calibration: 216 z-torque measurements with fixed sigma=1e-5 independent of response and moment; public/private bytes match. Positive nonzero unit-moment design makes moment identifiable by a strictly convex weighted fit.
input_and_packaging_review.public_api: Only fit returning self, finite numeric moment, and ordered one-dimensional NumPy prediction arrays are required.
input_and_packaging_review.packaging: Docker copies only README, model, public tests and data; author/hint/oracle/private tests remain outside the public image. Agent600/verifier60 and pinned dependencies retained.

grading_review.coverage: Three transverse component/phase groups and independent z anchors within the public domain.
grading_review.numerical_margin: Reported reference error is approximately 6e-12 on hidden cases; minimum hidden transverse absolute signal exceeds .0025; noise-induced oracle error stays below .00102. These are separated from the .04 gate and shortcut error above4.92.
grading_review.implementation_constraints: No internal solver, model form, root algorithm, or array intermediates are graded.
grading_review.regeneration: Only --generate writes calibration; final rerun read the existing data.

pre_freeze_change.description: One hidden phase changed from -.8 to -1.2 after the first validator flagged a near-zero physical transverse readout. Public apparatus, dynamics, calibration, grading threshold and instructions were unchanged; full validation was rerun before any model evaluation.
pre_freeze_change.purpose: Keep the physical torque signal away from a zero crossing.
